messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for rollout v1.23.0-rf at 2025-11-03T15:00:21Z. Canary advanced to 20%. Post-deploy quickchecks: all synthetic probes OK except eu-west embed p95 latency spike. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v1.23.0

maya: saw the alert in Sentry. p95 for eu-west jumped from ~1.1s to ~2.6s around 15:04 UTC. No error rate increase though.

sam: digging into traces now — attaching a short span view. looks like model-variant=v1.23-quant path has heavier kernel fallback in that region.

alex: we rolled quantized variant to canary for cost perf. maybe fallback to fp16 for eu? can we route region-specific variant?

rachel: suggest we halt automatic canary advance and pin eu-west to previous model until we confirm. keep other regions progressing.

lisa: infra-side — there's also a small warmup gap on kvcache for eu nodes; traffic skew could amplify p95. can we throttle canary traffic in eu while maintaining 20% globally?

sam: yes we can route eu traffic to model:v1.22 for that cluster. command below to pin region:```deployctl set-routing --region eu-west --model v1.22 --until 2025-11-03T16:00:00Z``` will revert after 1h unless we extend.

infra-bot: Action scheduled: routing change queued, will execute in 30s. Change-ID=chg_20251103_eu_pin_01. Audit: https://redwood.internal/audit/chg_20251103_eu_pin_01

maya: holding the canary advance in the release pipeline now. not promoting to 50% until we validate p95 back to baseline. opening an investigation ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4827

sam: follow-ups: (1) run a targeted synthetic with longer prompt lengths to stress kv warmup, (2) check kernel selection logs on eu infer nodes, (3) compare tokenization diff for v1.23. i'll post results in INF-4827.

rachel: good call. update release notes with the hold and the eu pin so CS/ops know. I'll add a short blurb.

maya: thanks — once infra-bot confirms routing change, we'll monitor p95 for 15m and then decide whether to resume rollout or rollback canary completely. :thumbsup:
